message.content:
I don’t have the ability to run commands directly from here, but you can get the current time on a Windows machine with a simple CMD command:

```cmd
time /t
```

Running that in a Command Prompt window will display something like:

```
10:45 AM
```

(Your actual output will show the current local time.)

If you need the exact timestamp (date + time), you can use PowerShell instead:

```powershell
Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
```

That will print something like:

```
2026-08-25 14:32:07
```

Feel free to copy‑paste either of those into your terminal to see the current time.
